name: vaultia-skills
description: All Vaultia skills: product requirements, UI/UX design, and architecture requirements for software teams.

interface.longDescription: Skills for software teams. product-requirements turns an idea into a testable PRD (WHAT and WHY); ui-ux-design turns it into screens built with a ready-made Base UI React kit; architecture-requirements turns it into a system design with APIs, data models, non-functional requirements, and ADRs (HOW and CONSTRAINTS). They work step by step with you: they propose options, show diagrams, and ask only the decisions that matter.
defaultPrompt: Write a PRD for a personal expense tracking app
Design the screens for this feature spec
Turn this PRD into a technical design
